name: 20-Minute Sit
title: Meditate 20 minutes per day.
subtitle: Meditation Dose
rationale: Twenty minutes matches the dose used in most formally studied mindfulness programs.
tierTarget: 20 minutes of meditation on most days

evidence.summary: Structured programs studied in meta-analyses typically use 20-45 minute daily practice; benefits at these doses are small to moderate and consistent.

sources.label: Meditation programs systematic review and meta-analysis

indications: Benefits are noticeable but plateau at the shorter dose.
